title: Patient Preparation Note: Fasting Tests and the Recollection Window
content:
A recollection of a Laboratory Test Orders specimen that includes a fasting test needs the patient to fast again. The recollection window of the accession is lengthened accordingly.

**Rule.** When a test that requires a 12-hour fast (test number 7600, Lipid Panel, or 36169, Vitamins A and E) stands on the accession as an ordered or add-on line that has not been credited, the recollection window is lengthened by **3 days**. When no 12-hour fasting test stands on the accession that way, but a test that requires an 8-hour fast (test number 10231, Comprehensive Metabolic Panel) does, the recollection window is lengthened by **2 days**. An accession with no fasting test receives no fasting lengthening.

| Uncredited ordered or add-on lines on the accession include | Lengthening |
|---|---|
| 7600 or 36169 (with or without 10231) | 3 days |
| 10231, and neither 7600 nor 36169 | 2 days |
| None of 7600, 36169 or 10231 | none |

**Points of judgement.**

- *A Lipid Panel line that was credited.* A credited line no longer stands on the accession, so it does not count toward the 12-hour lengthening.
- *Both a 12-hour and an 8-hour test.* The 12-hour test decides: 3 days, not 3 plus 2.
- *A Comprehensive Metabolic Panel added on after collection.* An accepted add-on line counts the same as an ordered line while it is not credited: 2 days, unless a 12-hour test also stands.
